name: Hidden Villa Farms Field Trip
description: PARENTS: A second permission slip went home this week in the white envelope from Hidden Villa Farms! This permission slip is also necessary for your child to be able to participate on the trip! Please make sure to return that to me by next Monday! It allows the kids to be able to interact with the animals and taste some of the edible plants they grow on the farm!

description: Have fun coming up with your crazy style!

name: Valentine's Day Celebration
description: PARENTS: Please make sure to bring 1 Valentine's card for all 22 friends in the class and to leave the "To" section of the card blank for easier pass out! Our bags were unexpectedly on the smaller side this year, so please keep goodies and prizes small this year!

name: Variety Show
description: Come show us what you've got! Sing, Rap, Dance, Lip Sync, Magic, Musical Instrument, Cheer Performance, Skit, Monologue, Jump Rope, Yo Yo, Puppet show, Comedy Routine, Impressions, Mime, Martial Arts demo, Poetry, Baton twirling.

description: Show this flyer for dine-in and take-out and enter code MAR580 for online orders, and 20% will go to the PTA!

name: Multicultural Fair
description: A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth (or starting one if it isn't represented yet!), fashion show, or with a group cultural performance.

name: Pioneer Crab Feed
description: Come hungry (and thirsty!) to the Pioneer High School Athletics 2026 Crab Feed. It's an all-you-can-eat + all-you-can-drink night that keeps the fun (and the cracking!) going.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!

name: Uniform Closet Volunteers Needed
description: The front office is in need of two volunteers to help organize the uniform closet during the minimum days we have in March.

name: Castillero PTA Board Positions
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants.

name: PTA Board Members Needed
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! Serving on the PTA Executive Board offers a behind-the-scenes look at how our fundraising efforts work and provides a direct way to support and strengthen our school community.
